title: First moment contraction for product noise
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive coordinate weights summing to $1$. For every $\rho$ with $0\le\rho\le1$ and every real-valued function $f$ on the product outcome space, the first moment norm of $T_\rho f$ under $P$ is at most the first moment norm of $f$ under $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite product of n coordinate probability spaces
Real-valued function f on product outcomes
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $0\le\rho\le1$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then $\|T_\rho f\|_{1,P}\le\|f\|_{1,P}$.
